create_jsonl_metrics_logger: create a JsonlMetricsLogger instance to log experiment metrics to a JSONL file in a given directory
log_metrics_with_step: log a dictionary of metrics with an optional global step using the JsonlMetricsLogger log_metrics method
log_text_to_jsonl: log a text string under a given key to the JSONL metrics file using the log_text method
sanitize_torch_tensors: sanitize a metrics dictionary by converting torch.Tensor values to Python floats using the _sanitize function
use_metrics_logger_context_manager: use the MetricsLogger as a context manager to automatically open and close the logger
